control_profile: Deterministic fifty-eight-percent gross exposure with common-market residualization, robust clipping, relative-rank admission, and symmetric long/short sizing; organizer stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes, time stops, turnover clipping, and volatility targeting are disabled.
falsifier: Reject the relative effect if it is absent from adjacent Monday anchors, unstable across eras, dependent on only one sleeve, or unable to survive stressed costs with an economical full-week holding period.
formation_horizon: seventy-eight completed weekly open-to-open observations at each of Monday 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 UTC, with a thirty-nine-week minimum
hypothesis: Coin-specific weekly seasonality remains after removing the contemporaneous crypto-market move: a Monday 08:00 UTC estimate shrunk twenty-five percent toward its adjacent Monday anchors should rank relative overperformance and underperformance over the next full week even when every asset has a positive absolute estimate.
rebalance_horizon: weekly Monday 08:00 UTC direct rebalance with continuous twenty-one-bar holding between decisions
